symptom: A caller-controlled response Proxy could repair a mismatching correction digest during the response shape's toJSON has trap or a later scalar descriptor read. The helper copied scalar fields first but deferred nested revision digests, so a mismatched entry-time response could become metadata-consistent. This never independently authenticated evidence or authorized scoring.
lesson: Pinning top-level scalar response descriptors is not a complete entry-boundary snapshot when a nested correction array remains live. Even an otherwise unnecessary toJSON membership check can invoke caller Proxy traps that mutate the nested evidence before its separate capture.
guardrail: Detach the complete bounded response graph in one descriptor-only pass before exact-shape checks and request preflight; only inspect the detached copy thereafter. Regression tests must execute a toJSON has trap and a later scalar descriptor mutation, require mismatch rejection, and preserve literal independentAuthorityVerified=false and scoringAuthorized=false. This is structural quarantine, not trust authentication.
